review_evidence: README identifies the project as an auxiliary Lean standard library supporting other Yatima developments.

A complete scan of all 70 Lean files found 474 declaration-style lines and 15 theorem/lemma/axiom/example-style declarations, including Nat.div2_lt, array/byte-array size lemmas, integer modular arithmetic facts and fixed-width integer serialization facts.

The library also defines polynomials and their arithmetic/division/Euclidean constructions, matrices, sparse matrices, rings, Zmod, multilinear extensions and related interfaces. These are directly reusable mathematical/formal prior art.
summary: Reviewed YatimaStdLib.lean and retain its mathematical data structures, algebraic constructions and proved utility lemmas.
